item.title: রোমে ডালমেশিয়ান কুকুরের সাথে ভিন্নধর্মী পোশাকে দেখা গেল কিম কার্দাশিয়ানকে
item.description: ফ্যাশনজগতে সাহসী উপস্থিতির জন্য পরিচিত মার্কিন তারকা কিম কার্দাশিয়ান পুনরায় খবরের শিরোনাম হয়েছেন। ইতালির রোম শহরে জোড়া ডালমেশিয়ান প্রজাতির কুকুরের পাশে সাদা-কালো বিন্দুকাজ করা পোশাক পরিধান করে নিজেকে আলোকচিত্রে তুলে ধরেছেন তিনি।

item.title: ব্যালন ডি’অর জয়ের আশায় লন্ডনের অনুষ্ঠানে সঙ্গী নিয়ে এসেছিলেন ইয়ামাল
item.description: সেরা ফুটবলারের খেতাব ব্যালন ডি’অর অর্জনে অন্যতম শীর্ষ প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী হিসেবে এগিয়ে ছিলেন ইয়ামাল। এই স্বীকৃতি পাওয়ার প্রত্যাশায় তিনি পূর্বপ্রস্তুতি গ্রহণ করেন এবং যুক্তরাজ্যের লন্ডনে আয়োজিত অনুষ্ঠানে আপনজনদের সাথে নিয়ে উপস্থিত হন।

item.title: India Clinches T20I Series Victory in New Zealand Following Strong Opening Start
item.description: A rapid partnership by opening batters Abhishek and Sooryavanshi secured a series win for India against New Zealand. The duo amassed 132 runs within the initial seven overs of their second-innings target chase.

item.title: Karnataka releases updated voter registry following intensive review
item.description: Karnataka has completed its Special Intensive Revision, resulting in the removal of over 9.93 million entries from the state's electoral register.

item.title: London removes traffic from Oxford Street for pedestrian trial
item.description: Vehicles are now barred from London's famous Oxford Street. Businesses anticipate increased sales, though locals have expressed concerns regarding the shift.

item.title: Israel holds vital elections amid claims of missing votes and fraud
item.description: Voters in Israel head to the polls for critical elections, accompanied by allegations concerning fraudulent activities and unaccounted ballots.

item.title: Stroke care webinar scheduled for October 28 by The Hindu and Kauvery
item.description: An online seminar organized by The Hindu and Kauvery Hospital will focus on prompt symptom detection, early diagnosis, and access to expert treatment.

item.title: Two London men face security charges over UK military base event
item.description: UK prosecutors state that 24-year-old British citizens Mohmed Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir face National Security Act violations following an incident at a US-operated base in England.

item.title: Ripley’s Believe It or Not! features
item.description: A feature presentation highlighting Ripley’s Believe It or Not! content.

item.title: Premier Bank marks anniversary under renaissance theme with honors
item.description: According to a press release, Premier Bank celebrated its founding anniversary by presenting special awards to dedicated staff members for their long-term service.

item.title: General Motors plans transition from NYSE to Nasdaq on Nov 17
item.description: GM will retain its existing 'GM' stock symbol during the move to Nasdaq. The automaker stated that investors do not need to perform any steps for the exchange.

item.title: Congo Ebola Epidemic Surpasses 10,000 Infections
item.description: Congolese health officials are struggling to contain the rapidly spreading Ebola epidemic as infections surpass 10,000. Nearly half of the diagnosed patients have died, while medical personnel face assaults and walkouts due to unpaid salaries.

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir Cabinet Expands with Four Ministers
item.description: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah inducted four new members into the Jammu and Kashmir ministerial council. Ali Mohammad Sagar, Mir Saifullah, Shamim Firdous, and Altaf Ahmad Wani took their oaths of office.

item.title: Kerala Police Officer Investigated for Theft of Recovered Phone
item.description: An officer in Kerala faces criminal charges for allegedly stealing and selling a misplaced mobile device valued at approximately 10,000 rupees. The gadget had earlier been turned in to local law enforcement after being discovered on a street.

item.title: Nordic Leaders Discuss Ukraine Conflict with Putin
item.description: The prime ministers of Finland and Norway held a direct conversation with Vladimir Putin concerning potential peace negotiations to resolve the war in Ukraine. Finnish leader Alexander Stubb additionally conferred with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

item.title: Sudanese Power Stations Damaged by Rapid Support Forces Drones
item.description: Drone strikes attributed to the RSF targeted five electricity facilities across Al-Jazira, Gedaref, and White Nile states. The attacks caused widespread blackouts throughout large areas of these three regions, according to an anonymous official.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Announces Bonuses for PSU Workers
item.description: Government employees in the 'C' and 'D' tiers at profitable state enterprises will receive an 8.33% bonus. Additionally, authorities announced an ex gratia payment of 11.67% for these personnel.

item.title: Ceasefire Negotiated in Occupied Ukrainian City of Oleshky
item.description: A truce brokered by Melania Trump has been established in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky to facilitate humanitarian aid. Ukrainian authorities expressed commitment to the agreement in order to deliver essential supplies to residents.

item.title: Delhi High Court Directs Removal of Remarks Against MP Dubey
item.description: The Delhi High Court instructed a former finance secretary to silence allegedly defamatory statements made against BJP parliamentarian Nishikant Dubey during a podcast. Additionally, counsel for TMC legislator Mahua Moitra promised to delete related posts on X.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Approaches Andhra Pradesh Coast
item.description: On October 27, 2026, Cyclone Arnab moved toward Andhra Pradesh, causing anxiety in Kakinada. Southern districts of Odisha also began experiencing rainfall as the storm advanced.

item.title: Fatima Payman Criticizes Prime Minister Over Parliament House Security
item.description: Senator Fatima Payman has pressed the prime minister regarding lawmaker safety concerns. In response, Anthony Albanese assured a prompt government action and considered installing panic alarms for politicians.

item.title: Bombay High Court to Review Imran Khan's Plea Regarding Departure Notice
item.description: Actor Imran Khan challenged an order demanding he exit India by November 14 following his attendance at a Mumbai political protest. His lawyers claim the directive violates constitutional rights, with a court hearing scheduled for November 2.

item.title: Golden State Valkyries Defeat Atlanta Dream in WNBA Finals
item.description: Solid defensive play and strong performances by Kiah Stokes and Veronica Burton propelled the Golden State Valkyries past the Atlanta Dream. The victory places the team one win away from claiming their inaugural championship title.

item.title: ভাবুক সম্রাট
item.description: ভাবুক সম্রাট।

item.title: Nepal-Linked Gang Apprehended in Murder Case of Former IPS Officer's Wife
item.description: Following a six-month investigation, authorities captured a Nepal-based criminal syndicate connected to the homicide of a retired IPS officer's spouse. Investigators noted the suspects had plotted identical crimes using domestic workers in Delhi and Bengaluru.

item.title: Chancellor Promises Lower Food Tariffs in Budget
item.description: Healey announced plans to eliminate import duties on everyday grocery items like marmalade and gherkins. This pre-Budget initiative aims to provide financial relief for households.

item.title: Coca-Cola Approaches Quarterly Financial Results Following Stock Surge
item.description: Beverage giant Coca-Cola is preparing to release its financial earnings report. The company's shares have advanced roughly 32 percent this year, pushing its market capitalization near $398 billion.

item.title: UPS Surpasses Quarterly Earnings Projections and Boosts Annual Outlook
item.description: Logistics firm UPS exceeded analyst forecasts for the third quarter. Consequently, the company has upgraded its full-year financial outlook for the second consecutive time.

item.title: ঘূর্ণিঝড় অর্ণব: দেশের চার সমুদ্রবন্দরে তিন নম্বর সতর্কসংকেত জারি
item.description: প্রবল ঘূর্ণিঝড় অর্ণবের প্রভাবে চট্টগ্রাম, কক্সবাজার, মোংলা ও পায়রা সমুদ্রবন্দরকে ৩ নম্বর স্থানীয় সতর্কসংকেত দেখিয়ে যেতে বলা হয়েছে।

item.title: Data Centers Spark Opposition Across the US
item.description: The rapid development of server facilities and related infrastructure has triggered widespread community resistance among voters across the United States in 2026.

item.title: হাসপাতাতালে চিকিৎসক সংকটে আড়াই বছর ধরে সিজার বন্ধ
item.description: উপজেলা স্বাস্থ্য কমপ্লেক্সে চিকিৎসক না থাকায় গত আড়াই বছর ধরে প্রসূতিদের অস্ত্রোপচার বন্ধ রয়েছে। ৩১ শয্যার এই প্রতিষ্ঠানে মোট ৩৫টি চিকিৎসকের পদ রয়েছে।

item.title: ধলিয়া সরকারি প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয়ে শিক্ষার্থীদের মাঝে উপহার বিতরণ

item.title: Telangana Faces Heavy Rain Alert Due to Cyclone Arnab
item.description: Cyclonic storm Arnab is expected to bring heavy to very heavy rainfall to four districts of Telangana on October 28, with four additional districts under a yellow alert.

item.title: PM Modi and Prince Alois Discuss Bilateral Cooperation
item.description: Prince Alois of Liechtenstein is visiting India from October 25 to 28 to strengthen bilateral relations in trade, investment, science, technology, and innovation.

item.title: শ্রমমন্ত্রী: দ্রুত মজুরি বোর্ড গঠন ও আন্দোলনে কড়া পদক্ষেপ
item.description: মঙ্গলবার সিরডাপ মিলনায়তনে এক সভা শেষে শ্রমমন্ত্রী আরিফুল হক চৌধুরী জানান, যত দ্রুত সম্ভব মজুরি বোর্ড গঠন করা হবে এবং এই ইস্যুতে আন্দোলনকারীদের বিরুদ্ধে ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া হবে।

item.title: বঞ্চিত প্রশাসন ক্যাডার কর্মকর্তাদের জ্যেষ্ঠতা পাওয়ার প্রসঙ্গ
item.description: বিসিএস পরীক্ষায় নিয়োগবঞ্চিত ২৮তম থেকে ৪১তম ব্যাচের কর্মকর্তাদের নিয়মানুযায়ী ব্যাচভিত্তিক জ্যেষ্ঠতা প্রদান করা উচিত বলে মনে করা হচ্ছে।

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Rewards WorldSkills Medallists
item.description: Chief Minister M.K. Stalin distributed cash awards to participants and medallists from Tamil Nadu who represented India at the WorldSkills Competition.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Prolongs Cross-Border Rough Stone Transit Prohibition
item.description: Tamil Nadu authorities have prolonged the restriction on moving rough stones and aggregates across state boundaries by an additional ninety days. This measure continues the temporary order initially enacted on July 27, though shipments to Puducherry and Karaikal remain exempt.

item.title: Supreme Court to Review Request on Complete SIR Documentation
item.description: The Supreme Court agreed to assess a petition involving opposition leader Rahul Gandhi and others requesting the preservation or submission of comprehensive SIR documents. The Election Commission previously stated in its affidavit that all actions followed legal standards and that the CEC's removal requires specific judicial procedures.

item.title: Power Outages Hit Eastern Dhaka and Portions of Chattogram
item.description: Electricity supplies suffered disruptions across parts of eastern Dhaka as well as specific zones within Chattogram. The power failures affected daily routines and local activities in those regions.

item.title: HSC Exam Results Publication Schedule Revised
item.description: Authorities have altered the official timeline for releasing the outcomes of the Higher Secondary Certificate and equivalent examinations. A new schedule will determine when candidates can access their grades.

item.title: CEC Removal Follows Supreme Court Judge Standards, Says ECI
item.description: In a joint affidavit, the Election Commission and top officials emphasized that the Chief Election Commissioner holds protections mirroring Supreme Court justices. The filing maintained that restricting the CEC violates the 2023 legislation and that Form 6 underwent no alterations.

item.title: Acer Launches Predator Gaming Handheld in the United States
item.description: Acer announced the upcoming US release and pricing of the Predator Atlas 8 portable gaming device. The higher-tier Intel Arc G3 Extreme version, originally revealed in May, will mark the company's first handheld entry in the American market.

item.title: ECI Issues Additional Declaration Requirements for Form 6
item.description: The Election Commission implemented a supplementary declaration alongside Form 6, asking voters to disclose prior electoral registration data for themselves or their ancestors. This development follows a Supreme Court announcement regarding the review of the updated application form.

item.title: Memories Shared as Karnafuli Garden City Shuts Down
item.description: Following the October 1 closure of the once-popular Karnafuli Garden City shopping mall in Kakrail by the shop owners association, citizens took to social media to share nostalgic childhood memories tied to the commercial center.

item.title: Patachitra Artisans Face Tradition and Change at Durga Puja
item.description: Artisans selling hand-painted goods at Kolkata Durga Puja pandals keep ancient sung-scroll traditions alive. These travelling storytellers now navigate the challenges of modern reinvention and cultural preservation.

item.title: Delhi Invites Pakistani Minister to SCO Civilisational Dialogue
item.description: For the first time since 2023, India invited a Pakistani minister to the inaugural SCO Civilisational Dialogue in November. Prime Minister Modi will open the event at the Purana Quila fort with delegates from over 25 nations.
